findings.authoredCue: Nika, Giulia and Elio meet in the working laundry. Giulia handles linen, Elio brings a shift list and trays, Nika takes notes.

findings.playerImpact: Mobile players cannot visually identify Elio as the third participant or recognize his assigned action from this illustration; this materially compromises the authored three-character composition.

minimumFix: Adjust only mobile presentation of the existing portrait asset so Elio's recognizable face and enough of his participation remain visible alongside Nika and Giulia; preserve dialogue readability and verify with a new 390x844 independent review.
